hooks.command:
python3 -c "
import json, sys
data = json.load(sys.stdin)
path = data.get('tool_input', {}).get('file_path', '')
skip = ['/integration/', '/__tests__/', '.test.', '.spec.', 'messages/', 'DOCUMENTACION', 'BACKLOG', 'TEST_PLAN', 'README', 'questions']
if path.endswith(('.ts', '.tsx')) and not any(s in path for s in skip):
    print('Code change in ' + path.split('/')[-1] + '. Before finishing: (1) unit/integration tests need adding or updating? (2) DOCUMENTACION.md, BACKLOG.md or TEST_PLAN.md need updating? (3) run npm run lint && npm run type-check to catch regressions.')
"
